scope: Disposable cloud history roundtrip; no source routing or live vault mutation
method: Restore the trusted history bundle into an exclusive private bare repository and compare its full manifest.
Create a fresh disposable Cloudflare Artifacts repository; record cleanup intent before creation.
Push every inventoried ref with an expected-absent guard, without retrying writes.
Fetch every ref into a new bare repository and compare refs, object IDs, types, byte lengths and raw SHA-256 digests.
Create a synthetic file commit, publish with the prior head lease, fetch and compare the complete updated graph.
Export the cloud readback, restore its bundle into another exclusive bare repository, and verify the synthetic file bytes.
Delete the owned disposable repository; retain private snapshots, bundles, manifests and method scripts.
limitations: Local operator rehearsal using Wrangler OAuth; does not qualify scheduled REST credentials.
History refs and object content only; ignored files, journals, database state and external symlink payloads were not uploaded.
No deployed Bob route, legacy-writer fencing, source-vault mutation or production routing change.
Cloud default branch configured to main; default-branch symbolic advertisement not independently asserted.
